items.title: ChatGPT’s new formatting blocks make its UI look more like a task tool
items.description: OpenAI has quietly rolled out 'formatting blocks,' which tweak GPT's layout to match the UI of the task it is supposed to execute. [...]

items.title: Google Now Allows Users to Change Their @gmail.com Email Address
items.description: For years, one of the most persistent frustrations for Google users has been the inability to alter their primary email address without creating an entirely new account. Whether you are stuck with an unprofessional handle created in high school or simply want a rebrand, Google has historically treated the @gmail.com username as a permanent fixture.
